meta.title: Friday
meta.description: Quick answers with web-search-only tools, a durable Inbox, and compressed promotion into workspace tasks.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Lightweight questions, kept outside your workspaces.
inbox.emptyHint: Press {hotkey} to start a quick conversation.

quick.hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line · Esc to hide

settings.defaultHint: Used by the next new conversation. Existing conversations keep their model.
settings.visionHint: Used automatically for image turns when the default model cannot read images.
settings.hotkeyHint: Default: Alt+Space (Option + Space on macOS). Works system-wide while DSH is running.
settings.retentionHint: Expired active conversations are archived and removed from the Inbox. Upgraded archives are retained.
settings.globalLimit: The native Friday panel starts with DSH and supports a system-wide hotkey, free dragging, and macOS Liquid Glass.
settings.keyConflict: That shortcut is already assigned or would interfere with typing.

dialog.upgradeDescription: Review and edit the compressed context. Creating a task only injects it and waits for your instruction; the Inbox original is archived.
dialog.deleteDescription: It will disappear from Inbox and be archived in DSH. This cannot be undone from Inbox.
dialog.clearDescription: All active Inbox conversations will be archived and hidden. Upgraded archives are not affected.
